verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents work with the Stripe API and search its documentation and support articles. It also documents a human-approval gate for sensitive write actions such as refunds and outbound payments. A runtime probe confirmed the hosted endpoint at mcp.stripe.com is live and returns the documented OAuth challenge. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP tools cover Agentic Commerce Suite flows specifically (checkout, SPTs, catalog), and independent hands-on reports of connecting an agent end-to-end.
